title: 5 Hidden Features in Claude Nobody Is Using
description: Most people open Claude and start typing. That's it. But there are 5 features buried in the settings that completely change how it works. Memory, Projects, Skills, Connectors, and Extended Thinking. Set these up and Claude goes from chatbot to actual assistant. I break down all 5 in under a minute.
